page.summary: Place a Boon where its actual team task will happen, maintain that useful zone, and relocate or abandon it when the team or Killer moves the fight elsewhere.

verdict.recommendation: Choose the team's needed zone effect and a totem location together; a network pays only while Survivors can use its local effects.
verdict.soloQ: Bless for an observable nearby heal, recovery, escape route or objective; do not assume strangers will travel to an unannounced zone.
verdict.coordinatedSwf: Assign a user and a maintainer for the selected zone, then call when its job moves so the next blessing has a purpose.
verdict.mainWeakness: Blessing time, totem placement, snuffing and Shattered Hope can remove the zone before teammates recover its setup cost.

options.whyItsHere: Supports teammate healing inside the zone when the team has an actual reset location; it does not supply self-healing.
Makes the zone a recovery answer when teammates may be left dying there; low value if the Killer picks up immediately or slugs elsewhere.
Protects movement through the zone from Killer scratch-mark and aura reads when that route will be used.
Adds nearby generator and chest information and faster blessing while a Boon is already active; it does not accelerate the first setup or a fully snuffed network.
Adds a local generator zone when a valuable repair target and a usable totem overlap.

soloQ: Choose a zone that teammates can visibly reach and use; if no one uses it, stop servicing it and work the next objective.
coordinatedSwf: Name the zone's task, the teammate using it and the next rotation before paying for repeated blessings.

weaknesses: A good effect in the wrong place is wasted; repeated snuffs can convert support into constant setup time.
killerCounterplay: The Killer can snuff the active Boon, pressure its users or destroy the totem with Shattered Hope.
commonMistakes: Blessing an available totem before choosing a heal, recovery route or generator it can support.
Reblessing the same exposed site after repeated snuffs.
Expecting Illumination's faster blessing while no Boon is active.

opening: Identify the next team task, then pick a reachable totem whose zone covers that task without pulling everyone away from safer work.

rows.situation: Injured teammates can regroup near a safe totem for healing each other.
rows.action: Bless for Circle of Healing, bring the teammate to that zone and return to objectives after the reset; skip it if the heal must happen elsewhere.
rows.why: The healing effect is shared and local, so the teammate has to use that location.

rows.situation: The Killer is leaving survivors dying near a reachable totem.
rows.action: Place or maintain Exponential where the slugged teammate can use it; if the Killer picks up or moves the down elsewhere, return to the more urgent save or repair.
rows.why: Recovery value depends on a dying teammate actually remaining in the zone.

rows.situation: The team's next route or repair target passes through a viable totem area.
rows.action: Choose Shadow Step for the used movement route or Steadfast for the generator inside the zone; do not set either where the team has already rotated away.
rows.why: Both benefits depend on useful geography, but answer different jobs.

rows.situation: A Boon is still active, but the team's next job has moved and a new totem can cover it.
rows.action: Relocate only when the next zone has a named user or task; Illumination can shorten this blessing while the existing Boon remains active.
rows.why: The faster blessing is conditional on having a Boon already, and relocation still costs time.

rows.situation: The Killer repeatedly snuffs the site, destroys its totem or forces teammates out of range.
rows.action: Stop rebuilding that zone; use a safer totem only for a live task, otherwise return to repair, rescue or direct healing.
rows.why: A denied network no longer repays setup.

abortWhen: Do not bless when no teammate or next objective can use the chosen zone.
After repeated snuffing, Shattered Hope or forced relocation, stop paying for an exposed location without a new task.
